setup: The equation has x on both sides: [[a]]x + [[b]] = [[c]]x + [[d]].

steps.say: The x terms must be gathered onto one side before x can be isolated. Moving [[c]]x across gives a difference of [[a]] − [[c]] = [[diff]] on the left.
The constants end up on the right: [[d]] − [[b]] = [[rhs]].
Dividing through by the coefficient finishes it.
